texts.li: {A_nameDef}'s secret is out: {SECRET}. Since then the dining room goes quiet whenever {A_nameDef} sits down, and a few people have started bolting their doors at night.\n\nNobody has done anything yet. But they keep coming to the council, one at a time and in low voices, asking what it means to do about {A_nameDef}. Some want {A_objective} watched. Some want the whole thing forgotten. One or two would like {A_objective} gone, and won't quite say so.

Everyone knows now: {SECRET}. {A_nameDef} hasn't denied any of it, and hasn't explained any of it either, and the silence is doing more damage than the truth did.\n\nThe colony has split down the middle. Half of it says people can change, and that {A_nameDef} has never given anyone here a reason to doubt it. The other half points out that a dangerous person would make very sure of exactly that.

li.label: Keep {A_nameDef} under watch for a season
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is never alone now: someone works the next field, sits at the next table, sleeps in the next room. The colony breathes easier. {A_nameDef} has stopped talking to almost anyone.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} is watched day and night now. It hasn't made {A_objective} any less dangerous, only angrier, and the people doing the watching are getting bored of it.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} work off the past
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} has taken the worst jobs in the colony for a while: the latrines, the corpses, the night hauling. Nobody asked for an apology and none came, but some of the looks have softened.

li.label: What's past is past
li.outcome: The council ruled that whatever {A_nameDef} did before arriving belongs to another life. Some agreed. Some have started counting the knives.

li.label: Have {A_nameDef} tell the whole story, at the fire
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} told it all at the fire that night, the worst parts too, and never once asked to be forgiven. Nobody left early. Afterwards, a few people sat with {A_objective} until the embers went out.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} told it all at the fire and held nothing back. That turned out to be the trouble: some of the details were worse than anyone had imagined, and people started getting up and leaving long before the end.

texts.li: A message came over the comms this morning, polite and very well informed. Somebody out there has heard what everyone here now knows ({SECRET}), and a band of bounty hunters would like to collect {A_nameDef}.\n\nThey aren't asking the colony to fight anyone. They want a time when {A_nameDef} will be out alone, and a gate left shut when they come. For that they will pay 300 silver, today, before anyone has done a thing.

News travels the trade roads faster than caravans do. A hunter calling {A_nameDef} by name has offered the colony 300 silver for nothing more than the hour {A_nameDef} goes out alone, and a promise that nobody will interfere.\n\n{A_nameDef} knows about the offer. Everyone knows. {A_nameDef} has stopped going out alone, and has started watching the council's faces very closely.

li.label: Take the silver and tell them
li.outcome: The council took the hunters' silver and told them what they wanted to know. The hunters never came. Maybe they found an easier bounty; maybe they're waiting. {A_nameDef} sleeps with a knife now, and nobody here can blame {A_objective} for it.

li.label: Sell them a false trail
li.outcome: The council sold the hunters a story about {A_nameDef} heading north with a caravan, and took 150 silver for the trouble. The hunters thanked everyone very politely and went north.
li.riskOutcome: The council sold the hunters a story about {A_nameDef} heading north, and took their silver for it. A week later a second message came, which said only: north was empty. Everyone has been watching the tree line since.

li.label: Refuse, and tell them the gate stays shut
li.outcome: The council told the hunters that {A_nameDef} belongs to this colony and that the gate stays shut. The reply was short and polite, and nobody has been able to stop thinking about how polite it was.

texts.li: {A_nameDef}'s secret is out: {SECRET}. Nobody has said a word against {A_possessive} doctoring since. Nobody has needed to. The last two patients asked for someone else, and the one before that wanted to know exactly what was in the syringe.\n\nThe council has to decide whether {A_nameDef} still treats the sick here. The sick would like an answer before the next raid, not after.

There is a gash on someone's arm that needs stitching, {A_nameDef} is standing at the medicine shelf, and nobody is moving. Everyone knows now ({SECRET}), and everyone is thinking the same thing.\n\n{A_nameDef} has said nothing in {A_possessive} own defense. The council has been asked, by the patient most of all, who holds the needle from now on.

li.label: {A_nameDef} keeps doctoring, as before
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} went back to the medicine shelf with the council's blessing. The patients still flinch a little at the needle. Fewer of them every week.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} went back to the medicine shelf with the council's blessing. The first patient flinched so hard at the needle that {A_nameDef}'s hands have been shaking ever since. They'll steady. Probably.

li.label: Only with someone else watching
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} still treats the sick, with a second pair of eyes on every stitch. It's slower. {A_nameDef} hates it, and is getting noticeably better.

li.label: Take {A_possessive} instruments away
li.outcome: The council took {A_nameDef}'s instruments and gave them to someone else. The colony has one less doctor and, according to some, one less worry. {A_nameDef} has been very quiet since.

texts.li: Ever since {A_nameDef}'s secret came out ({SECRET}), {B_nameDef} has not stopped talking about it. At meals, on shift, to anyone who will listen and several who won't, with a new detail every time.\n\n{A_nameDef} has asked the council to make it stop. {B_nameDef} says this is a free colony and the truth is the truth.

{B_nameDef} has turned {A_nameDef}'s secret into the colony's favorite story. Everyone has heard it by now ({SECRET}), most of them twice, and the version going round has grown some parts {A_nameDef} swears never happened.\n\n{A_nameDef} came to the council red-faced and asked for it to end. {B_nameDef} came too, to point out that nobody has been told anything untrue. Mostly.

li.label: Order {B_nameDef} to drop the subject
li.outcome: The council told {B_nameDef} to drop it, and {B_nameDef} has. Out loud, at least. The eyebrows still say plenty.
li.riskOutcome: The council told {B_nameDef} to drop it. {B_nameDef} did, and has been telling everyone since that the council is protecting {A_nameDef} for reasons of its own.

li.label: Make {B_nameDef} apologize in front of everyone
li.outcome: {B_nameDef} apologized to {A_nameDef} at supper, in front of everyone, in a voice that could have frozen soup. It counted. Nobody has repeated the story since, at least not where {A_nameDef} can hear.
li.riskOutcome: The apology began well enough and ended with {B_nameDef} explaining, in front of everyone, exactly why {A_nameDef} deserved every word of the gossip. {A_nameDef} answered with a fist.

li.label: Sit them down until they sort it out
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} were shut in the council room with a pot of tea and told not to come out until it was settled. It took most of a day. They came out talking.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} were shut in the council room together to sort it out. The teapot didn't survive. Neither did the truce.

li.label: It's out. People will talk
li.outcome: The council decided there was nothing to be done about talk. {B_nameDef} took that as permission, and {A_nameDef} took it as an answer.

texts.li: The pirates have long memories, and now they have the colony's comms frequency too. A message came for {A_nameDef} this morning, read aloud by whoever picked it up before anyone thought not to: the old debt, with interest, 400 silver, or they will come and collect it some other way.\n\n{A_nameDef} has asked the council for help, quietly, without quite looking anyone in the eye.

Everyone knows about {A_nameDef}'s debt now, including, it turns out, the people {A_nameDef} owes. Their message was short: 400 silver with the next caravan, and they will consider the matter closed.\n\nIt's a lot of silver. It's also a lot of pirates. {A_nameDef} hasn't slept properly since the message came, and has asked the council what it means to do.

li.label: Pay it, all of it
li.outcome: The silver went out with the next caravan, and a short reply came back: the matter is closed. {A_nameDef} has been working like two people ever since, as if that might square it.

li.label: Pay it, and {A_nameDef} works it off
li.outcome: The colony paid the pirates, and {A_nameDef} is paying the colony: every dirty job and every long shift, until the council says it's square. Nobody expects that to be soon.

li.label: Send half, and haggle
li.outcome: The pirates took 200 silver and a long, flattering letter. Their reply was rude, but it was also final, and {A_nameDef} will take final.
li.riskOutcome: The pirates took the 200 silver and sent back a single word: half. {A_nameDef} has taken to watching the horizon, and so has everyone else.

li.label: Not one coin
li.outcome: The council sent the pirates nothing. {A_nameDef} has been told it's {A_possessive} debt and {A_possessive} problem, and has taken that about as well as anyone would.
li.riskOutcome: The council sent the pirates nothing. Their answer came two days later and said only that they were disappointed. Nobody in the colony has slept well since.

texts.li: The colony knows now: {SECRET}. {A_nameDef} has spent the days since trying very hard to be somewhere else, and failing, because people keep finding {A_objective} to say thank you.\n\nSome want the council to mark it properly, at supper, in front of everyone. Others suspect {A_nameDef} would rather dig a hole and live in it.

It's out ({SECRET}), and the colony doesn't quite know what to do with it. People have been leaving small things at {A_nameDef}'s door: a carved spoon, a good apple, a note that just says "we know".\n\nThe council has been asked to do something proper about it. {A_nameDef} has asked the council, very firmly, to do nothing at all.

li.label: Raise a cup to {A_objective} at supper
li.outcome: The council put on a proper supper and the whole colony raised a cup to {A_nameDef}, who went the color of a beet and said nothing at all. It was, by every account, a lovely evening.
li.riskOutcome: The whole colony raised a cup to {A_nameDef} at supper. {A_nameDef} mumbled something into the cup, left before the food was served and spent the evening hiding in the storeroom. The colony has decided this counts as a thank-you.

li.label: Thank {A_objective} quietly, in private
li.outcome: The council thanked {A_nameDef} in private, in a few plain words, and left it there. {A_nameDef} seemed relieved. The rest of the colony feels it got off lightly.

li.label: Make it everyone's job from now on
li.outcome: The council put {A_nameDef} in charge of a rota: mending, blankets, birthdays and all. Some of the others are finding out that kindness on a schedule is a great deal of work.

texts.li: Since {A_nameDef}'s secret came out ({SECRET}), people have been holding their breath when {A_nameDef} walks past. Nobody knows whether there's anything to catch, and nobody wants to be the one who finds out.\n\n{B_nameDef}, who knows more medicine than most here, has offered to examine everyone. Others want {A_nameDef} moved to a room apart until they're sure. {A_nameDef} points out that {A_pronoun} has been sleeping a wall away from them all for months, and nobody has so much as sneezed.

Half the colony has started eating at the far end of the room from {A_nameDef}, and the other half is embarrassed about it. Everyone has heard by now ({SECRET}), and nobody is sure what it means for the rest of them.\n\n{B_nameDef} wants a proper examination of everyone before anyone panics. Some of the others would rather keep {A_nameDef} apart first and examine afterwards.

li.label: A room apart, until it's certain
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} has a room apart now, with meals left at the door and visitors talking through it. Nothing has been caught. Nobody is quite ready to say so.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} lasted two days alone in that room, then walked out of it, past everyone, without a word. Nobody tried to stop {A_objective}.

li.label: {B_nameDef} examines everyone
li.outcome: {B_nameDef} spent two days poking, prodding and listening to everyone's chests, and announced that the colony is as healthy as it ever was. Grumbling about cold hands has replaced grumbling about {A_nameDef}.
li.riskOutcome: {B_nameDef} examined everyone, found nothing at all and said so. About half the colony believes it. The other half has started washing its hands a great deal.

li.label: No quarantine, no fuss
li.outcome: The council said there was nothing to fear, and asked everyone to behave as if they believed it. Most do. {A_nameDef} has noticed the ones who don't.

texts.li: Ever since everyone learned about {A_nameDef}'s years in the death pits, {B_nameDef} has been asking for a demonstration. Just one bout, friendly, in the yard, with half the colony watching and the other half pretending not to.\n\n{A_nameDef} has said no, twice. {B_nameDef} has started telling people that {A_nameDef} is afraid. The council has been asked to settle it, one way or the other.

Word of {A_nameDef}'s past in the pits has gone round the colony, and now there's a betting pool. {B_nameDef} has put up a challenge, and a good part of the colony has put up silver on how long {B_pronoun} will last.\n\n{A_nameDef} wants nothing to do with it. Most of the bettors want the council to let the fight go ahead.

li.label: One bout, by the rules
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} had their bout in the yard, and the colony got its show. Afterwards {A_nameDef} walked away without looking at anyone, the way people walk away from something they swore they'd never do again.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} teach fighting instead
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} turned the challenge into a class. {B_nameDef} got a bout of sorts: forty rounds of footwork drills, and bruises in places nobody knew could bruise. Half the colony signed up for the next one.

li.label: No fighting. The pits are behind {A_objective}
li.outcome: The council forbade the bout. {A_nameDef} looked relieved for the first time in days. {B_nameDef} and the betting pool did not.
li.riskOutcome: The council forbade the bout. {B_nameDef} tried one more taunt anyway, in the dining room, and found out in about two seconds why {A_nameDef} used to be a champion.

texts.li: Since the truth came out ({SECRET}), {A_nameDef} has stopped pretending. The hands shake in the mornings now, openly, and the hiding place behind the storeroom is empty because everyone knows where it is.\n\n{B_nameDef} has offered to stay with {A_nameDef} through the worst of getting clean, if the council will spare them both for a week. Others want {A_nameDef}'s room searched, and whatever is found burned.

Now that it's out, {A_nameDef} has admitted all of it: the using, the hiding, how long it's been going on. Asked what {A_pronoun} needs, {A_nameDef} said a week. Asked what the colony needs, a few people said a lock on the medicine cabinet.\n\n{B_nameDef} has said {B_pronoun} will see {A_nameDef} through it, if the council allows. Not everyone thinks the council should be in the business of second chances.

li.label: A week off, with {B_nameDef} beside {A_objective}
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} have been excused from work for a week. It was a hard week, full of shakes and sweats and bargaining, and {A_nameDef} is still clean at the end of it.
li.riskOutcome: The week was harder than either of them expected. {B_nameDef} has barely slept, sitting up through the shakes and the bargaining. {A_nameDef} is clean this morning. {B_nameDef} is asleep on the floor beside the bed.

li.label: Search {A_possessive} room and burn what's found
li.outcome: The council had {A_nameDef}'s room turned out and everything found in it burned in the yard. The colony feels safer. {A_nameDef} hasn't said a word to anyone since.
li.riskOutcome: The search turned up a second stash nobody had known about, and {A_nameDef} took its burning badly. Things were thrown. Some of them were furniture.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} handle it alone
li.outcome: The council decided this was {A_nameDef}'s fight. {A_nameDef} has been fighting it alone and, so far, just about winning.
li.riskOutcome: Left to handle it alone, {A_nameDef} lasted three days. Today is a bad one.

texts.li: {A_nameDef}'s secret is out ({SECRET}), and it's all anyone has talked about for days. Conversations stop when {A_nameDef} walks in, then start again, more quietly, when {A_nameDef} leaves.\n\nThe colony wants to talk about it properly, once, and be done with it. The question is whether that would help {A_nameDef}, or only the people who want to hear it.

Nobody can quite let it go. Everyone knows now ({SECRET}), and everyone has an opinion, and most of those opinions have been shared with {A_nameDef} whether {A_pronoun} wanted them or not.\n\nThe council has been asked to settle how the colony deals with it. {A_nameDef} would like a say in that, too.

li.label: Talk it through at the fire
li.outcome: The colony sat around the fire and {A_nameDef} answered every question, the kind ones and the other ones. By the end the questions had run out, and people were just talking.
li.riskOutcome: The fire went well until somebody asked the wrong question and somebody else laughed. {A_nameDef} answered everything after that in single words, and left early.

li.label: The subject is closed
li.outcome: The council ruled that the matter is closed and nobody is to bring it up again. Nobody does, out loud. {A_nameDef} can eat dinner in peace.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} decide
li.outcome: The council left it to {A_nameDef}, who thought about it for a day and decided to carry on exactly as before. The colony is slowly following that lead.
li.riskOutcome: The council left it to {A_nameDef}, who decided to say nothing at all. The colony has filled the silence with its own versions, and some of them are worse than the truth.
